verdict.rationale: Square's marketing pages say it uses machine learning to spot and block payment fraud, and that sellers can set custom rules and alerts to manage risk. That is Square's own capability, which counts toward this story. But the evidence is two thin marketing lines, with no documentation of how scores or rules work. Missing for 10: per-transaction ML fraud scores visible to the user, explicit block/review/allow rule actions and a rule-authoring interface, in-depth first-party docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
